quantize_linear_modules: quantize a PyTorch module replacing Linear layers with quantized int8 or fp16 versions
quantize_rnn_modules: quantize a PyTorch module replacing LSTM or GRU layers with quantized versions
create_quantized_linear: create a QuantizedLinear module from an existing PyTorch Linear layer with int8 weight quantization
create_quantized_lstm: create a QuantizedLSTM module from an existing PyTorch LSTM layer with quantized cell parameters
create_quantized_gru: create a QuantizedGRU module from an existing PyTorch GRU layer with quantized cell parameters
